Render a Self-Contained SLURM sbatch Array Submission Script

Source: R/sbatch.R
render_sbatch_script.Rd

Generates a POSIX/bash-safe SLURM batch script configured from a slurmpilot_resources plan (with strict defense against #SBATCH newline, shell metacharacter, path traversal, and CLI flag injection). Supports surgical array index overrides, Apptainer container execution, environment modules, and structured logging.

Usage

render_sbatch_script(
  job_name,
  resources,
  work_dir,
  worker_script = "worker.R",
  array_indices = NULL,
  attempt = 1L,
  container_sif = NULL,
  container_binds = character(),
  modules = character(),
  env_vars = list(),
  log_dir = "logs",
  mail_user = NULL,
  mail_type = NULL,
  extra_sbatch = character(),
  output_path = NULL
)

Arguments

job_name

Character SLURM --job-name (validated against control characters/metacharacters and sanitized).

resources

A slurmpilot_resources object from estimate_resources() or resource_spec().

work_dir

Remote or local working directory containing payload.rds, chunks.rds, and worker_script.

worker_script

Filename or path of the worker script (default "worker.R").

array_indices

Optional integer vector overriding --array for surgical retries of specific failed chunks.

attempt

Positive integer submission attempt number passed to worker.R via SLURMPILOT_ATTEMPT. Default 1L.

container_sif

Optional path to an Apptainer/Singularity .sif image. When supplied, wraps Rscript inside apptainer exec --cleanenv.

container_binds

Optional character vector of Apptainer --bind mount specifications (e.g. "/scratch:/scratch"). work_dir is always bound automatically when container_sif is set.

modules

Optional character vector of HPC environment modules to load via module load.

env_vars

Optional named list or character vector of extra environment variables exported in the job script.

log_dir

Relative subdirectory inside work_dir for SLURM stdout/stderr logs. Default "logs".

mail_user

Optional email address for --mail-user.

mail_type

Optional SLURM --mail-type (e.g., "END,FAIL").

extra_sbatch

Optional character vector of extra #SBATCH flags (without leading #SBATCH; --wrap and shell metacharacters are forbidden).

output_path

Optional file path to write the rendered .sbatch script.

Value

An S3 object of class "slurmpilot_sbatch" with script (character vector of lines), text (single string), path, job_name, array_spec, and resources.

See also

estimate_resources(), build_apptainer_def(), render_worker_script()

Examples

res <- resource_spec(n_tasks = 40, chunk_size = 4, mem_mb = 2048, time_minutes = 20)
sb <- render_sbatch_script("mc_power", res, work_dir = "/scratch/user/mc_power")
cat(sb$text)
#> #!/usr/bin/env bash
#> #SBATCH --job-name=mc_power
#> #SBATCH --array=1-10
#> #SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1
#> #SBATCH --mem=2G
#> #SBATCH --time=00:20:00
#> #SBATCH --output=/scratch/user/mc_power/logs/chunk_%a.out
#> #SBATCH --error=/scratch/user/mc_power/logs/chunk_%a.err
#> 
#> set -euo pipefail
#> 
#> WORK_DIR='/scratch/user/mc_power'
#> mkdir -p "${WORK_DIR}/logs" "${WORK_DIR}/results" "${WORK_DIR}/status"
#> cd "${WORK_DIR}"
#> 
#> export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
#> export OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
#> export MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
#> export SLURMPILOT_WORK_DIR="${WORK_DIR}"
#> export SLURMPILOT_CHUNK_ID="${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID}"
#> export SLURMPILOT_ATTEMPT=1
#> 
#> echo "[slurmpilot] Starting job ${SLURM_JOB_ID:-local} array task ${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID} on $(hostname)"
#> Rscript "${WORK_DIR}/worker.R" --work-dir "${WORK_DIR}" --chunk-id "${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID}" --attempt "1"
